answer:
I can't see the repository and have no tools, so this is from memory of Dispatch's frontend and I haven't verified it.

As I recall, the Cases table opens at 25 rows per page. The initial value is applied in the table component, `src/dispatch/static/dispatch/src/case/Table.vue`, which seeds the options on load. The Vuex module for cases (`src/dispatch/static/dispatch/src/case/store.js`) declares a different default of 10 in its `tables.rows.options` (`itemsPerPage`), which matches Vuetify's own default.

I'm not certain of these numbers or of which file overrides the other. Check `itemsPerPage` in both files to confirm.

DEFAULT: 25
FILE: src/dispatch/static/dispatch/src/case/Table.vue
STORE_DEFAULT: 10
